vendors.name: Loggro Restobar
vendors.reason: Colombian restaurant POS (COP plans, e.g. Básico $120.990/mes); its 'Menú Digital' is a QR menu ('Puedes tener un código QR por mesa o para pedidos online.') with orders sent to the till; no pickup / para llevar / scheduled-order wording; delivery only via marketplace integrations (Rappi). QR-menu-only for our rule.

vendors.name: Menüpp

Loggro Restobar (Colombian POS, COP plans) has only a QR menu ('código QR por mesa o para pedidos online') and Rappi integration — not_relevant.
